blinding_guess.why: tf 1.11.4 is a thin wrapper that calls many underscore-prefixed tf2 buffer internals (_chainAsVector, _getFrameStrings, _allFramesAsDot with no argument, _getLatestCommonTime, _frameExists, _lookupFrameNumber, _getParent) plus tf2_ros::Buffer timeout overloads; package.xml requires tf2/tf2_ros >= 0.5.4 to build but only >= 0.4.5 to run, so it could run against a tf2 that lacks or changed these members, but nothing in the snapshot shows that any listed element is actually missing or mismatched.
